name: Whisper Tiny (multilingual)
description: Multilingual Whisper tiny weights in ggml form, repackaged by Talex-Touch for the on-device Tuff speech runtime. Roughly 2x faster than whisper-base on the same host and sample, at the cost of accuracy. Not the recommended install: it exists as the low-latency / low-footprint fallback. Emits Traditional Chinese for zh audio, so the runtime must apply Simplified conversion.

benchmark.notes: Same host and same single sample as whisper-base@1.0.0. Content transcribed correctly; script was Traditional. One sample only — treat the 2.2x latency ratio as directional, not a quality claim.
